visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals, a man in a black t-shirt and purple cap and a person in a light blue denim jacket, stand in a modern, well-equipped kitchen. The man gestures toward a white bitter melon on a cutting board while the other person listens attentively. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the white bitter melon. A hand wearing a white glove points at the large, rounded bumps on the surface of the vegetable to highlight its quality. (3) The gloved hand uses a knife to carefully trim the white bitter melon, focusing on the outer edges and removing the inner fibrous parts. The lighting is bright and even. (4) The man in the black t-shirt speaks directly toward the camera, using expressive hand movements to explain a culinary technique. The background shows kitchen utensils and plants. (5) White granulated sugar is poured into a metal pan containing clear water. The camera captures the particles dissolving as they hit the liquid. (6) Slices of the trimmed bitter melon are added to the boiling sugar water. The person in the denim jacket uses a slotted spoon to stir the pieces gently. (7) The blanched bitter melon is lifted out of the pan and immediately submerged into a bowl of cold water and ice. Steam rises from the hot vegetable. (8) A close-up shows the texture of the bitter melon after blanching, appearing slightly translucent. The man continues to explain the purpose of this step.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a culinary tutorial aimed at teaching viewers professional techniques for selecting and prepping white bitter melon to significantly reduce its inherent bitterness. By demonstrating steps like choosing large-grained melons, removing specific parts, and blanching in sugar water followed by an ice bath, the content provides actionable advice for home cooks.
